Pro add-ons ​

ProEvery add-on on this page is Sikshya Pro. Each card below tells you the minimum plan tier (Starter, Pro / Growth, Scale). For a flat one-card-per-add-on view plus a tier matrix, see All add-ons.View pricing →

Sikshya Pro is a separate plugin you install on top of the free Sikshya LMS. After activating your license under Sikshya → License, you toggle individual add-ons in Sikshya → Add-ons.

License plans control which add-ons you can turn on:

  • Starter — entry-level paid tier.
  • Pro / Growth — most use cases.
  • Scale — agency, enterprise, marketplace.

Below is every add-on with what it does, where it lives in the admin, and an "Upgrade" link.

PROCompare plans

All plans include free updates and priority support. Pick the plan that includes the add-ons you need — you can always upgrade later.

Compare Sikshya Pro plans →

Build (curriculum & assets) ​

Course bundles ​

Sell several courses for one bundled price ("bootcamp pack"). Buyers are auto-enrolled in every course in the bundle.

  • Where: Sikshya → Course → Courses → New → Course type: Bundle and Commerce → Bundles.
  • Plan: Pro / Growth.
PROCourse bundles
Unlock bundles →

Course reviews & ratings ​

Star ratings and written reviews on the course page, with admin moderation.

  • Where: Sikshya → Course → Reviews after enabling the add-on; per-course toggle in Course Builder → Course options.
  • Plan: Starter.
PROCourse reviews & ratings
Unlock reviews →

In-course discussion threads and Q&A panel with instructor moderation. Great for cohort programs.

Manage your add-ons ​

Open Sikshya → Add-ons:

  • Search the catalog by name.
  • Filter by category (course, commerce, learner, communication, analytics, integrations, etc.).
  • Tier filter (Starter / Pro / Scale).
  • Sort by importance, name, tier, or status.

Each card shows:

  • Title, short description, hover About this add-on popover.
  • Plan badge: Free, Starter, Growth, or Scale.
  • An on / off toggle. Toggles are locked with an "Upgrade" prompt if your plan doesn't include the add-on.

Use the Select visible + Enable selected / Disable selected to bulk-manage.

Disabling an add-on hides its UI but keeps your data. Re-enable later to bring it back.
